title.romaji: Saikyou no Shien-shoku [Wajutsushi] Dearu Ore wa Sekai Saikyou Clan wo Shitagaeru
title.english: The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan
title.native: 最凶の支援職【話術士】である俺は世界最強クランを従える

description:
Noel is the grandson of legendary Seeker Overdeath and dreams of surpassing his strength. But it turns out that Noel is nothing but a Talker, the weakest class of them all. Undeterred, he uses his silver tongue to gather allies, develop cunning strategies, and form the greatest clan around. Now, as the most notorious Talker, Noel will do whatever it takes to claim supremacy.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Each episode streamed a week in advance on some streaming services. The original TV broadcast started on October 7th, 2024.

name.native: ノエル・シュトーレン

node.description:
__Job:__ Talker
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

~!__Job:__ Tactician
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest!~


Following in the footsteps of his heroic grandfather, he aims to be the "Strongest Seeker". However, his job is "Talker" which is regarded as the weakest. Knowing that, Noel worked hard persistently to fulfil his ambition. Despite the merciless methods he employed for the sake of his ambition, which is considered "evil". Noel’s distinct talent attracted many powerful people and they began to gather under him.

node.description: The person who serves as one of the advisors to the Sub-Leader of the Luciano Family and also is the Don of one of their affiliates, the Bargini Family. The entire of his life is comprised of extreme dual natures.

The undefeated Swordman from an island nation in the Far East. His swordsmanship is outstanding, and his slashing skills are top-notch. However, he is bound by a slave contract and cannot disobey his master's orders.

She is an elf with distinctive ears. She cares about Noel in many ways.

node.description:
__Job:__ God of destruction
__Cluster:__ Bloodblade Federation

Noel's grandfather. Once a famous and strongest Seeker in the Imperial Capital. He was known as "Over Death" and feared by the others. He was Noel's mentor and trained him to become a better Seeker.

__Job:__ Healer
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

She is mild-mannered and also likable. She cares about Noel. Coupled with the Job of Healer, she's very popular with men.

She is in a romantic relationship with Lloyd.

__Job:__ Mimic
__Cluster:__ Informant

The Imperial Capital's best informant breaker. "Mimic" allows Loki to change his appearance into anything he wants. He is good at disguising himself as other people.

__Job:__ Knight
__Cluster:__ Sky Wing Knights

~!__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest!~

He is the leader of the B-rank party, "Sky Wing Knights", whose motto is "solidity and humility". He has the personality of a well-behaved honor student, and has a refreshing, white knight-like aura. Apart from his attractive appearance, he is among the most skilled B-rank seekers.

__Job:__ Warrior
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

He has a hotheaded personality and often acts on instinct, but is an excellent "Warrior."

He is in love with Tania.

__Job:__ Swordman
__Cluster:__ Lightning Bite

A swordsman who serves as the leader of the party. He has a high opinion of Noel and even invited him to join his party.

__Job:__ Swordman
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

He is a swordsman who serves as the leader of the party "The Blue Beyond". He has an attractive face stands out among the crowd of rough Seekers and is popular with women. 

He is the party's oldest member, and volunteered to become the leader. He is in a romantic relationship with Tania.

name.native: アルバート・ガンビーノ

The previous boss suddenly died, so he took over the Gambino Family. He has been called a living disaster due to his arrogant behavior.
